# High-frequency source expansion fixtures

Captured 2026-11-17 from WHO FluNet, PHAC and SPF official endpoints using the live collection adapters. FluNet country rows and SPF rows are bounded original excerpts; the dictionary, PHAC source page/binding/CSV and SPF metadata are complete captured resources. Full source artifacts and hashes are recorded in provenance.json. Excerpts do not claim complete historical coverage.
